resources.string: GenStudio is an independent creative service. Image, video, and 3D generation use metered computing resources, storage, and maintenance. Credits are required to run generation tasks; signing in does not start a purchase or subscription.

GenStudio uses account, upload, prompt, device, billing, ad reward, and task data only to provide, secure, support, bill, and improve the creative service.\n\nUploaded files and generated outputs are temporary. We do not sell personal information, and we do not train models on private uploads or outputs unless we ask for separate permission.

By using GenStudio, you agree to follow the current Terms of Service, AI acceptable-use rules, payment terms, and privacy choices. Do not create illegal, harmful, deceptive, harassing, non-consensual sexual, child exploitative, scam, or rights-violating content.
